title: a LoRA project
description: <home>/projects/<slug>/project.yaml: what the project is, which type and families, and where its images live. Person-owned: kiln reads it and changes it only through `kiln project` verbs; status and goal live in state.json.

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

trigger.description: the verified trigger token; null until `spec approve`

class_word.description: the plain noun captions use, for example robot or woman

roots.description: every images.jsonl line names one of these in `root`

images.description: where root: images files live, for example {images_root}; read-only

imports.description: where kiln copies imported images: projects/<slug>/images

legacy_output.description: a host workspace's render output, for example {output_root}

adopted.description: true = exported from an existing workspace; freeze then defaults to --from the latest snapshot

family_id.description: a model family id: the stem of families/<id>.yaml

legacy.description: columns of the exported store that have no field here yet, kept verbatim by the exporter; tools ignore this block

legacy_id.description: the record's id in the store it was exported from; null for records made here. Kept so a migrated record can be traced back; never shown in public text

rating.description: content rating; unknown is treated as not sfw (policy.unknown_rating_is)

relpath.description: a path relative to the root its record names: forward slashes, no drive, no leading slash, no `..`

rootpath.description: a folder relative to the instance root, or one that starts with a config token such as {images_root}, {models_root} or {output_root}; never an absolute path

sha16.description: a resource id: the first 16 hex digits of the file's sha256

sha256.description: lower-case hex sha256 of the file bytes

slug.description: a project slug, for example demo_robot

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00. New records always use T and carry the UTC offset; times exported from an older store may use a space and lack the offset.
